findings.title: All app imports start eagerly at module initialization
findings.body: Each `import()` is executed while constructing `appStore`, so importing this module immediately starts loading every app package rather than loading a package only when its entry is accessed. This defeats the intended on-demand loading and can retain the startup cost and memory use of loading all app modules.

findings.title: Recurring cancellation does not wait for calendar deletions
findings.body: The async callbacks passed to `forEach` are not awaited. With the new async `getCalendar`, each callback pauses before scheduling its deletes, while execution proceeds to `Promise.all(apiDeletes)` before those callbacks push anything into the array. The cancellation can therefore finish and report success without deleting any recurring booking events from calendars.

findings.title: Reschedule returns before integration cancellations complete
findings.body: The async callbacks passed to `forEach` are not awaited. They now suspend while `getCalendar` loads the app, but the handler proceeds to send the reschedule email and return without waiting for calendar or video cancellation. The old booking can remain on external calendars or video services after a successful reschedule.
